[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.rr\.tv\/.*?Version/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /https:\/\/api.rr.tv\/storage\/business\/rootName\/app\/homePage\?dataType=JSON/i then reject_dict(200)

[Rule]

DOMAIN-SUFFIX, ebp.renren.com,REJECT

DOMAIN-SUFFIX, bolt.jebe.renren.com,REJECT

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% api.rr.tv
